statements.text: Dambach enters her 20th season at the helm in University Park heading into the 2026 campaign, Penn State’s 33rd varsity season.

Penn State University appointed Erica Dambach as the third head women’s soccer coach in Nittany Lion program history on Thursday, February 8, 2007, setting in motion one of the greatest coaching tenures in Penn State history.
